commits.message:
Add home.xhtml and PrimeFaces 8 dependency setup.

Introduced a basic home.xhtml page with a welcome message in Spanish. Updated the project to include PrimeFaces 8.0 Jakarta through the WEB-INF lib folder for compatibility.

Add database configuration builder with closure delegation

Introduce `DatabaseConfig` and its nested classes to define server, credentials, and connection properties using closures with delegate-first strategy. Includes a builder for configuring and displaying database setup, exemplified with a sample usage.

Signed-off-by: Alejandro <aguerreroegido@gmail.com>

Add shopping cart functionality with pricing rules

Implemented a Groovy-based shopping cart system with support for configurable pricing rules using closures. Features include item addition, tax, discount, and fee calculations, showcasing delegation in Groovy for concise pricing logic.

Signed-off-by: Alejandro <aguerreroegido@gmail.com>

Add advanced Groovy functional programming examples

Introduced examples for memoization, currying, and trampolining with closures to optimize performance and handle recursion efficiently. Included practical use cases like statistical calculations and large recursive processes.

Signed-off-by: Alejandro <aguerreroegido@gmail.com>

Add Decorator, Command, and Composite pattern examples

This commit includes the implementation of three design patterns: Decorator, Command, and Composite. Each pattern is demonstrated with Groovy examples and practical use cases, focusing on reusability, dynamic behavior, and simplicity of implementation. These additions aim to enhance understanding and serve as a reference for design pattern usage in Groovy.

Signed-off-by: Alejandro <aguerreroegido@gmail.com>

Add initial project setup with examples and dependencies

This commit introduces the initial setup of the project, including .gitignore files for various IDEs and systems. It adds libraries for Groovy 4.0.14 and several sample implementations like closures, patterns (Chain of Responsibility, Bouncer), DSLs, and basic Groovy syntax examples (lists, maps, arrays).

Signed-off-by: Alejandro <aguerreroegido@gmail.com>

Add task management functionality with JSF and PrimeFaces

Implemented `TareasBean` and `TituloBean` for task management and dynamic page titles. Added `listado-tareas.xhtml` page with a form and data table to display and add tasks. Updated templates and navigation to integrate the new feature.

Fix UI updates, improve logging, and sync callback params

Updated UI component IDs and AJAX update targets for better compatibility. Corrected JavaScript callback parameter names for consistency with the backend. Enhanced logging in `UserBean` and added IntelliJ VCS configuration file to version control.

Add initial project setup and functionality

This commit introduces the foundational configuration and code for the project. It includes Maven wrapper scripts, IDE-specific settings, and essential backend and frontend components like `MovieBean`, `MovieManager`, and related UI pages for movie ratings.

Add initial project files and dependencies

This commit includes the initial setup of the JSF 3 and PrimeFaces 2 web application. It adds necessary classes, JAR dependencies, configuration files, and resources, including Jakarta EE APIs, Hibernate libraries, and UI theme assets. Additionally, basic project structure and metadata files have been set up.
